_note: Stage 8 voice catalogue. Each speaking persona: a fallback prebuilt voice, the voice design prompt (permanent traits drawn from the public persona: apparent age, work, region, temperament; an accent only where the public persona implies a second language, kept subtle and intelligible, never from the subject's role) and a short delivery style drawn from the case family's speaking style (verbosity, register, fluency, language), never from the subject's role and never from affect, so nothing in a voice is a stress cue (PRB-4). voice_id is the stored project voice scripts/design_voices.py created from the prompt (null until designed). Synthetic characters only: no voice is replicated from a real person.

subject:Jordan Pell.description: A man in his late thirties who has fixed building systems for years: a warm, slightly husky baritone with a neutral American accent, practical and plainspoken.
subject:Jordan Pell.style: plainspoken and casual, keeps answers short

subject:Mara Quell.description: A records clerk in her mid forties: a measured, clear alto with a neutral American accent, precise and orderly.
subject:Mara Quell.style: formal and unhurried, explains at length and now and then searches for a word

subject:Avery Lindqvist.style: formal and careful, explains at length in clear second-language English
